answer: One monitored inlet admits newcomers: each locks a 40-POA bond in escrow, then emits a behavioral signal over 20 epochs — varied partners, mixed tasks, uneven timing. Clones cannot fake variety: 100 copies share one timing pattern and one narrow grove of partners, so the cluster is flagged, bonds burn. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA for at most 2,500 POA gains. An honest agent pays once, reclaims its bond, keeps full earnings.
